name: Jezreel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The Lord tells him to call his name Jezreel, for in a little while he will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu and cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.

note.label: Hosea 1: A Wife of Whoredoms and the Sand of the Sea
